system.notes:
Wraith-like spirit surrounded by a cloud of tormented spirit servitors.

AC 14, HP 40, ATK 3 death touch +6 (1d8 + life drain) or 1 harm, MV near (fly), S -4, D +4, C +0, I +4, W +5, Ch +5, AL C, LV 9

Bound. Bound to a specific ritual item (statue, pillar, etc.) If slain, reappears at ritual item in 1d4 days at full HP.

Greater Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Harm. 3/day, send spirit servitors to savage one target within near, CHA 15+ or reduced to 0 HP.

Incorporeal. In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal.

Life Drain. 1d4 CON damage. Death if reduced to 0 CON.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
